Designed as an immersive theme park attraction, it prioritizes visceral thrills and an intense, fast-paced encounter with iconic characters and a dystopian future. It's a non-stop adrenaline rush for fans seeking an immediate, impactful sci-fi adventure.

flags.essence_text: A dark and twisting neo-noir mystery set against the backdrop of Hollywood. This psychological thriller unravels a dreamlike narrative with an unreliable narrator, pulling the viewer into a world of intrigue and paranoia. Expect to be captivated by its intense atmosphere, surreal imagery, and complex plot. The film's ambiguity and dream logic demand careful attention, rewarding multiple viewings.
flags.synopsis: "This is the original TV pilot version of Mulholland Drive (2001), which was rejected by ABC and failed to become a series. David Lynch considers this version of the project embarrassing and did not released it to the public. However, a VHS copy from the time of its release did find its way online. The existing pilot was reworked with new footage to create the feature film two years later."
